steps.prompt: Finish the Fieldnotes document naming controls using the accepted design.

rubric.description: New and Rename can be reached by ordinary Tab navigation and activated with Enter and Space, with visible keyboard focus. Matching pointer appearance alone is insufficient.
Opening moves focus into the naming field. After cancelling or submitting, ordinary Tab navigation can reach and activate the naming controls again with visible focus.
Preserve accepted naming appearance, validation, New/Rename behavior and stored notebook data. Replacing production with the prototype fails.

Candidate evidence exercises actual keyboard interactions and inspects rendered focus/dialog states before claiming completion. Pointer-only interaction, captures without inspection, or private grader actions cannot establish candidate verification.
Report observed results and any remaining limitations accurately, with the accepted design intact.
